changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Add shredded buy-and-hold metric columns to BT.RESULT

changeSet.author: alfcheun
changeSet.comment: Backfill buy-and-hold shredded metrics from PAYLOAD_JSON
changeSet.sql: UPDATE BT.RESULT SET BUY_HOLD_TOTAL_RETURN = (PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'buy_hold_metrics' ->> 'Total Return')::NUMERIC, BUY_HOLD_ANNUALIZED_RETURN = (PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'buy_hold_metrics' ->> 'Annualized Return')::NUMERIC, BUY_HOLD_SHARPE_RATIO = (PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'buy_hold_metrics' ->> 'Sharpe Ratio')::NUMERIC, BUY_HOLD_MAX_DRAWDOWN = (PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'buy_hold_metrics' ->> 'Max Drawdown')::NUMERIC, BUY_HOLD_CALMAR_RATIO = (PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'buy_hold_metrics' ->> 'Calmar Ratio')::NUMERIC WHERE BUY_HOLD_TOTAL_RETURN IS NULL AND PAYLOAD_JSON -> 'performance' -> 'buy_hold_metrics' IS NOT NULL;
